Jamal Murray scored the Nuggets' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 23 times in 81 starts, or 28% of the games they started. Nikola Jokic was next with 22. The Nuggets made the game's first field goal in 52% of their 88 games and won 54% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
